_comment: Single source of truth for the four app releases. Read by scripts/releases.mjs (build, dev server, homepage placeholders), public/go.php (redirects), src/workspace/registry.ts (workspace) and tests/server/releases.test.ts. When a new version lands: put the web build in versions/<app>-web-<ver>/ and its zip in versions/zip/ (the layout the ArtCraft releases come in), run `npm run versions` to see what is newer, update this file, then npm run build. Windows sizes are the exact asset sizes of the GitHub release (since 2026-11 x64 and ARM64 only; a missing arch is simply not listed); webZipBytes is the size of the zip the downloads link serves (versions/zip-web/ wins over versions/zip/ when a repacked zip with a one-click launcher exists). An app may run an older browser build than its release: then web and webVersion name that build and webNote says why. patches lists startup fixes that scripts/patch-apps.mjs applies to a web build (it checks the bytes first).
